_: The composed journeys' records (11-validation.md §1), walked 7 Oct by Daisy. buat-perjalanan.mts writes each into its journey's README. Evidence: render/laporan.txt (axe, targets, sideways scroll, every screen at 1280, 1024 and 390 px) and render/jalan/ (the keyboard walk at three widths, motion on and reduced, the Tab stops of every screen, and each screen's accessibility tree). The screen-reader check is a review of the accessibility tree, not a screen reader.

periksa.catatan: One primary per screen: «Terbitkan», «Siapkan», «Sediakan». Studio and Kelas are lists; their next action is the row.
The navigation's current place, the heading and the page title agree on every screen (the walk checks the title). Back links name their destination.

periksa.cek: Every action answered, then its result in words
periksa.catatan: «Menerbitkan…» at once, then «✓ Diterbitkan» and «Terbit sejak …»; «Menyediakan…», then «✓ Disediakan» and «Materi disediakan untuk kelas ini.», each with the way on.
Every state is a word («Selesai», «Sekarang», «Terbit», «Tersedia»); the current step also carries aria-current.
Nothing under 24 px. At 390 the top bar's «Keluar» is the 36 px small button the Button rule allows.
Studio's five tabs scroll inside their row (Tabs rule); see finding F10.

Walked by Tab and Enter alone: 36 presses at 1280 and 1024, 31 at 390. The skip link is first, shows on focus and lands on the main region; every stop shows the ring; nothing hides under the sticky bar. A date field is three stops and the browser's own calendar button.
Landmarks: the navigation «Tempat kerja Anda» and main. The working button is aria-busy; the result is a status. A real screen reader is still owed.
Nothing moves under reduced motion. With motion on: 120, 160 and 240 ms only, 8 px of travel at most; the working dot pulses and stops under reduced motion.
At 390, Studio's tabs hide «Bank Soal» and «Uji Cepat» beyond the edge with no sign that more follow (F10).

temuan: F1 · JQ1: the definition's teacher who publishes is two people in PINTAR.
C2: the publishing copy says «Siswa» and «menugaskan» where the teacher's screens say «murid» and «Sediakan».
F5: the App shell, Confirmation, Specimen and Action feedback specimens have a teacher publish to a class.
F11: «Tinjauan sebelum disediakan» is a review before the act, not a Confirmation.

periksa.catatan: The class table is for reading: no primary button, the search field leads. «Minta membaca lagi» is the one primary of its form.
Three levels, so the scope line «Kelas / Kelas 5A / Bab 3»; Kelas is current in the navigation; the title follows.

periksa.cek: Every action answered, then its result in words
periksa.catatan: The search filters as typed and the count says «Menampilkan … dari 31 murid»; the menu opens on its first item; «Mengirim…», then «✓ Terkirim» and «Permintaan dikirim kepada Ayu Lestari.» (a request inside PINTAR, not an email).
Each state is a badge with its words; the stripe is never a state.
Nothing under 24 px. «Lihat» in each row is the 36 px small button for rows.

The page does not scroll sideways; the table scrolls in its frame with the name held still, as the Table rule says. But the state is cut at the frame's edge and the row's actions are only reached by scrolling the table (F7).

28 presses for the whole walk. Arrows move in the menu, Enter takes the item; the dialog opens on «Batal»; Esc closes it and gives focus back to the account button, or the drawer row at 390; Esc closes the drawer back to «Buka menu».
The table has a caption; each row action carries the learner's name («Lihat Adi Pratama», «Opsi untuk Adi Pratama»); the filter is a radio group.
The menu, the drawer and the dialog appear without moving; with motion on they enter in 240 ms with 4 to 8 px of travel.
The dialog's confirm reads «Ya, keluar dari semua» (C1).

temuan: F1 · JQ2: a teacher has no consequential act on one learner; the dialog is met on «Keluar dari semua perangkat», and the product's three lists are one table here.
F2: the Table and Table rows specimens offer acts a teacher cannot do, and «Kirim pengingat».

periksa.catatan: Kelas is a list; Pembelajaran Saya leads to the one open course; the course has one primary.
At 1280 and in the drawer the group labels «Mengajar» and «Belajar» say which context is open. At 1024 the rail drops them and the two contexts become one column of icons (F8).

periksa.cek: Every action answered, then its result in words
periksa.catatan: A place's link shows the working dot until the page is there.
36 px «Keluar» in the 390 top bar.
Found and corrected: the top bar was 3 px too wide with «Pembelajaran Saya» (the App shell's main column now holds its width).
13 presses at 1280 and 1024 (through the navigation), 10 at 390 (through the drawer).
Each group is a list named by its label; the course's steps are a list with the current step marked.

temuan: JQ3: an educator's own learning stays in the staff shell.
F8 · JQ7: the rail at 1024 px loses the two contexts.

periksa.catatan: «Lanjutkan pelajaran», «Berikutnya», «Simpan jawaban ini», then «Beranda». «Kumpulkan» stands apart, secondary, with its consequence in words.
«Belajar» is the current tab; inside the assessment the focus shell hides the tabs and the eyebrow says «Uji Penguasaan · Bab 3».

periksa.cek: Every action answered, then its result in words
periksa.catatan: «Menyimpan…», then «✓ Tersimpan» and «Sudah dijawab: 7 dari 10.»
Every choice is a 44 px row.
15 presses; the arrows move the choice inside the question.
The stem is the choices' legend, so each choice is read with its question.

temuan: F11: the assessment's «Kumpulkan» panel is a review before the act, not a Confirmation.
F12: the shell documents say a learner is never named; D-020 greets by first name here («Halo, Bagas»).

periksa.catatan: «Sediakan».

periksa.cek: Every action answered, then its result in words
periksa.catatan: The mistake is told under «Sampai» in the server's own sentence and focus goes there; correcting the date clears it; then «Menyediakan…», «✓ Disediakan» and the window in words.
The error has its icon and words, and the field is marked invalid as well as outlined.
The two date fields stack.

22 presses at 1280 and 1024, 17 at 390. A native date field is three stops and the browser's own calendar button, which draws its own ring. Its order of day, month and year follows the device's language: on a device set to English it reads mm/dd/yyyy, which is why the date in words sits beneath (question 15).
The error and the date in words are tied to their field.
Field outlines change at 120 ms with motion on, at once under reduced motion.

temuan: F1 · JQ5: an Uji Cepat has no opening date; the window of «Siapkan» is composed instead.
F3: the Date and time specimen says «Uji Cepat dibuka».

The band says «MODE PERAGAAN · Sedang melihat sebagai: Murid · Kelas 5A» on the screen, but the page title is the learner's own «Belajar · PINTAR» (F9).

periksa.cek: Every action answered, then its result in words
periksa.catatan: Leaving says «Anda sudah keluar dari peragaan.» (new words).
The deep ink says «MODE PERAGAAN» in words; its links are underlined.
«Lihat sebagai» is the 36 px small button for rows.
The band wraps to two lines.
The band's two ways out are the first stops after the skip link.
The band is a region named «MODE PERAGAAN».

F9: the page title inside the room.
F12: «Halo, Bagas» under the band follows D-020, against the shell documents' wording.

periksa.catatan: A wrong PIN is told under its field (kunci.tidak_cocok.2).
36 px «Keluar» in the 390 top bar.
Found and corrected: a review step's long English label pushed the page to 450 px; review steps now wrap.

20 presses at 1280 and 1024, 15 at 390. The warning is announced (an alert) wherever focus is, and «Saya masih di sini» is reached from the page. The walk puts focus on each new screen's heading; the product's lock puts it on the PIN field when a PIN can be used (LayarTerkunci), and that rule stands.
The warning is an alert with its own heading; the wrong-PIN line is an alert tied to the field.
